summary: Clackamas County, OR ground site in Mount Hood NF: firefinder and camp in 1929, L-4 cab in the 1930s, staffed 1943-45, removed or destroyed 1966; a hiking guide now describes a hike to it.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a ground site, with a firefinder and camp in 1929 before it
facts.status_note: Removed in 1966 per firetower.org and the Forest Lookouts page (undated), destroyed that year per firelookout.com; no source gives a detailed description of what remains

staffing.status: Frank Deuell staffed the station 1943-45 (Forest Lookouts page); Pat and Dennis Lynch named as lookouts without dates

access.note: Oregon Hikers guide describes it as a hike destination; no closure or permit is described

visit.trail_note: Oregon Hikers guide lists the West Zigzag Mountain hike, 11.2 mi with 3,635 ft gain, as reaching the site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org says the lookout was removed in 1966; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Brief record (ground kind, gone status, 2010 FFLOS registration) confirmed. The 1930s build date has no exact year, so no built event was recorded. The footings line on the Mount Hood history page sits between the West and East Zigzag passages and does not name a site, so it is reported with that caveat. The Oregon Hikers page is undated (oldid 103138). The firetower.org photo credited to Pat Lynch (circa 1957) is captioned only, so no photo record was added. The AWS abbreviation is not expanded in the source.
